title: What If Everyone Stopped Eating Meat and Dairy Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if the world quit meat and dairy? The biggest change wouldn't be the menu.
Meat and dairy use about 83 percent of the world's farmland, yet supply only 18 percent of our calories.
Without them, a 2018 Oxford study estimates farmland could shrink by more than 75 percent.
That's an area about the size of the United States, China, the EU and Australia put together.
Meat and dairy also account for about 60 percent of agriculture's greenhouse gas emissions.
But the same study says meat and dairy still provide 37 percent of our protein. Replacing that would be the hard part.
